# MDX rendered as Markdown

The Reader accepts `.mdx` in V1, but renders it as ordinary Markdown. The JSX
below is inert text, never a component and never executed.

export const answer = 42

<Callout tone="warning">This must display as source-like Markdown content, not run.</Callout>

## Still just Markdown

- expressions like {answer} have no special meaning in V1
- imports do not load
- JSX does not create elements
